errors.text: The proposed nano-precipitation intervention does not reconstruct the target 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT treatment.
No processing route, precipitate chemistry, size, volume fraction, or spatial distribution is specified, so the intervention is not reproducible.
Treating precipitates simply as dislocation obstacles does not establish relief of boundary pile-ups; additional obstacles can instead increase local back stress and pile-up severity.
The hypothesis omits the target mediator of coherent FCC/B2 interfaces and the associated preferential transfer of dislocations between phases.
No prior evidence is cited, and the predicted mechanical improvement is qualitative rather than quantitatively testable against the reported approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% elongation.
